academy.title: Learn from the hand that knows the way
academy.subtitle: Music programmes with working artists, carrying heritage knowledge and technique straight from the stage to the student.
academy.tracksSubtitle: Specialist programmes built to take you from sharpening a passion all the way to the stage.
academy.tracksEmpty: No teaching tracks are available right now.
academy.valuesSubtitle: A live training method that builds skill from direct experience, not from theory recited back.
academy.value1Body: Never more than eight participants, so every student gets real focus, individual guidance and room to grow.
academy.value2Body: Teachers who are working artists in their field, passing on practical experience from stages and studios.
academy.value3Body: Every programme ends with a full show in front of a real audience, so the student actually stands on a stage.
academy.newsletterTagline: ♪ But worth every bit of the wait.
academy.newsletterBody: Workshop news, exclusive writing on music and ideas, and upcoming show details before anyone else.

booking.title: Your occasion deserves real music. ♪
booking.contextClearTitle: Clear the selection and send a general request
booking.successBody: Thank you for reaching out. We will review your request and contact you within 48 hours to discuss the details and confirm arrangements.
booking.successNote: Your request has been recorded in our secure private booking records, and the artistic coordinator will contact you directly by phone or email.
booking.fieldArtistAny: The full Andalusia ensemble / complete heritage package
booking.fieldSpecificArtistPlaceholder: For example: a solo oud player, or a five-piece takht
booking.fieldDetailsPlaceholder: Tell us about your occasion, the venue, the number of guests, and any special requests…
booking.fieldDetailsHint: Enter at least 5 characters describing what the event needs.
booking.consent: By sending this form I agree to the terms of use and the privacy policy.
booking.contactBody: Get in touch directly for anything urgent, or to arrange an event with particular requirements:
booking.step1Title: We receive and review your request
booking.step1Body: We read through the occasion, the type of event and your artistic needs to work out the best options.
booking.step2Body: The bookings team gets in touch to talk through the programme, the budget and the dates.
booking.step3Title: We propose the artist and programme
booking.step3Body: We design a programme that suits the occasion, with audio samples and the logistics worked out.
booking.step4Body: We finalise the agreement and coordinate with the ensemble and crew to deliver an exceptional evening.
booking.noPrepayment: No online prepayment — arrangements are agreed directly with the management.
booking.heroSubtitle: Music programmes with real artists in small, intensive settings — an experience that changes your path.
